description:
In crate-jmap-chat-server/src/message.rs handle_message_set:

Create path: if the create payload has a non-empty broadcastMentions array, check that the sender has mention_broadcast permission in the target Space. Reject with forbidden if not. For group chats not part of any Space, broadcast mentions are unrestricted (spec §4.4.1).

Update path: same check when the update adds or retains a broadcast mention (spec §4.11 update semantics — 'The same mention_broadcast permission check applied at create time applies to updates that add or retain a broadcast mention').

Rich-body path: if bodyType is rich and body contains one or more 'broadcast' spans, the same permission check applies.

mention_broadcast already exists in crate-jmap-chat-types/src/vocabulary.rs:48. The permission resolution infrastructure (caller's effective permissions in a Space) already exists from bd:JMAP-g7wu.2.4.3.
title: Enforce mention_broadcast permission on Message/set
